description: This is a Java source file implementing the PaymentService interface, providing payment processing functionalities such as obtaining payment methods, processing transactions (authorization, capture, refund), and validating credit card details within a SalesManager e-commerce system.

classes.name: PaymentServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing payment processing logic such as retrieving payment methods, configuring payment modules, executing transactions (authorization, capture, refund), and validating credit card info within the sales management system.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available payment integration modules for a given merchant store, filtered by store region.

methods.name: getAcceptedPaymentMethods
methods.description: Returns the list of activated payment methods that are accepted for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByType
methods.description: Fetches a specific payment module by its type for a store.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a specific payment module by its code for a store.

methods.name: getPaymentConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the configuration details for a specific payment module code within a store.

methods.name: getPaymentModulesConfigured
methods.description: Loads and returns all payment modules configurations for a store from merchant configuration storage, decrypting stored data.

methods.name: savePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates and saves the configuration data for a payment module for a merchant store.

methods.name: removePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Deletes a specific payment module configuration from a store.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Executes a payment transaction (authorize, authorize and capture, or init) based on provided payment details, customer, store, and order data.

methods.name: getPaymentModule
methods.description: Returns a payment module implementation by its code.

methods.name: processCapturePayment
methods.description: Processes a capture payment for an order, capturing a previous authorization transaction.

methods.name: processRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for an order, possibly partial, updating order totals and statuses accordingly.

methods.name: validateCreditCard
methods.description: Validates credit card number, expiration date, and performs Luhn check based on card type.

methods.name: validateCreditCardDate
methods.description: Checks if credit card expiration date is valid (not in the past).

methods.name: validateCreditCardNumber
methods.description: Validates credit card number based on type and Luhn checksum.

methods.name: luhnValidate
methods.description: Performs Luhn algorithm validation on the credit card number to verify correctness.
